description_en: Queries information about Active Directory (AD) accounts in an AD office network (formerly known as a workspace) that is connected to an AD domain
description_zh: 查询AD办公网络（原工作区）对接AD域后获取的AD账号信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecd list-office-site-users --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --filter 0jin0 --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-3633530000 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --max-results 10 --ou-path example.com/Domain_Controllers --assigned-info example-string --sort-type example-string --include-assigned-user true --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListOfficeSiteUsers
